name: impeccable
description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
one_liner: A style guide and rulebook that stops AI coding tools from producing the same generic-looking website every time, so AI-built apps look custom-designed instead of templated.
buyer: A solo founder or freelancer who builds their product's frontend almost entirely with AI coding tools and is embarrassed that it looks like every other 'AI-built SaaS'.
business_use_cases: A no-code-adjacent founder installs it before building their MVP so investors and early users don't immediately clock it as 'AI slop'.
A freelance 'AI app builder' uses it on every client project as a quality/differentiation guarantee.
A design agency offers a 'polish pass' service that runs a client's AI-generated app through this ruleset and fixes what it flags.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'design polish' service for founders whose AI-built app looks generic.
Sell a premium extended rule pack / theme pack beyond the free base tool.

steal_this: Run it against three AI-built landing pages you can find this weekend, fix the flagged issues, and offer the before/after as a 'free audit' to land your first paying design-polish client.
